mapper.select: SELECT id, review_type, review_date, completed, good_things, bad_things, wasted_time, unfinished, biggest_gain, next_focus, ai_summary, metrics_json, period_start, period_end FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_type = #{type} ORDER BY review_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, review_type, review_date, completed, good_things, bad_things, wasted_time, unfinished, biggest_gain, next_focus, ai_summary, metrics_json, period_start, period_end FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_type = #{type} AND review_date = #{date}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review(user_id, review_type, review_date, completed, good_things, bad_things, wasted_time, unfinished, biggest_gain, next_focus, ai_summary, metrics_json, period_start, period_end) VALUES (#{userId}, #{r.reviewType}, #{r.reviewDate}, COALESCE(#{r.completed}, FALSE), #{r.goodThings}, #{r.badThings}, #{r.wastedTime}, #{r.unfinished}, #{r.biggestGain}, #{r.nextFocus}, #{r.aiSummary}, #{r.metricsJson}, #{r.periodStart}, #{r.periodEnd}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, review_type, review_date) DO UPDATE SET completed = EXCLUDED.completed, good_things = EXCLUDED.good_things, bad_things = EXCLUDED.bad_things, wasted_time = EXCLUDED.wasted_time, unfinished = EXCLUDED.unfinished, biggest_gain = EXCLUDED.biggest_gain, next_focus = EXCLUDED.next_focus, metrics_json = EXCLUDED.metrics_json, period_start = EXCLUDED.period_start, period_end = EXCLUDED.period_end, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET ai_summary = #{summary}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND review_type = #{type}
